'''Crystal guards''' were a part of the [[Umbaran commando]]s and were responsible for guarding and transporting [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]].<ref name="Scars" /> In [[3629 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|5.4}}</ref> a crystal guard [[Squad One (Umbaran)|squad]] was attacked by the [[Eternal Alliance]] while transporting crystals on a [[Train/Legends|train]].<ref name="Scars" />
{{Military-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Crystal guards first appeared in<ref name="Scars" /> the short story "[[Trading Scars]]" written by [[Samantha Wallschlaeger]]<ref name="Tweet">{{Twitter|StillNotSam|status/898274643756421120|[[Samantha Wallschlaeger]]|quote=So, um... I'm really self-conscious about my prose and it took a lot of guts for me to write this little short story, so I'm proud I did it!|archivedate=20200814154941}}</ref> and published in the developer blog for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' on [[August 17]], [[2017]].<ref name="Scars" />
